_why: 3.6: HOLD PERSON SCROLL, read in a fight by a fighter who never learned the spell and has no slots. The scroll's own target scan (fight_read_hold_person_target) picks the weakest living humanoid in medium reach, resolve_cast_hold_person spends the scroll instead of a slot, and the reader holds its concentration. Expect the Wisdom save and, on a failure, Paralyzed.
